## 宏定义
$!{define.vm}
##定义初始变量
#set($ClassName = $tool.append($tableInfo.name, "Service"))
#set($EntityDO = $tool.append($tableInfo.name, "DO"))
#set($entityDO = $tool.firstLowerCase($EntityDO))
#set($EntityDetailDTO = $tool.append($tableInfo.name, "DetailDTO"))
#set($entityDetailDTO = $tool.firstLowerCase($EntityDetailDTO))
#set($EntityPageDTO = $tool.append($tableInfo.name, "PageDTO"))
#set($entityPageDTO = $tool.firstLowerCase($EntityPageDTO))
#set($EntityQueryDTO = $tool.append($tableInfo.name, "QueryDTO"))
#set($entityQueryDTO = $tool.firstLowerCase($EntityQueryDTO))
#set($Entity = $tableInfo.name)
#set($Entitys = $tool.append($Entity, "s"))
#set($entity = $tool.firstLowerCase($tableInfo.name))
#set($entitys = $tool.append($entity, "s"))
#set($Comment = $!{tableInfo.comment})
##设置回调
$!callback.setFileName($tool.append($ClassName, ".java"))
$!callback.setSavePath($tool.append($tableInfo.savePath, "/service"))
$!callback.setReformat(true)

#if($tableInfo.savePackageName)
package $!{tableInfo.savePackageName}.service;
#end

import com.github.wz2cool.dynamic.SortDirection;
import com.github.wz2cool.dynamic.model.NormPagingResult;
import com.innodealing.onshore.bondmetadata.enums.Deleted;
#if($tableInfo.savePackageName)
import $!{tableInfo.savePackageName}.model.dto.$!{EntityDetailDTO};
import $!{tableInfo.savePackageName}.model.dto.request.$!{EntityQueryDTO};
import $!{tableInfo.savePackageName}.model.dto.response.$!{EntityPageDTO};
import $!{tableInfo.savePackageName}.model.entity.$!{schemaName}.$!{EntityDO};
#end

import java.util.Collection;

 /**
 * $!{Comment}表Service层 {@link $!{EntityDO}}
 *
 * @author $!author
 */
public interface $!{ClassName} {

    /**
     * 新增数据处理
     *
     * @param userId                           		   用户id
     * @param $!{entityDetailDTO}					   用户请求对象
     */
    void insert$!{Entity}(Long userId, $!{EntityDetailDTO} $!{entityDetailDTO});

    /**
     * 更新 deleted 字段
     *
     * @param userId  用户id
     * @param ids     主键集合
     * @param deleted 删除状态
     */
    void updateDeletedByIds(Long userId, Collection<Long> ids, Deleted deleted);

    /**
     * 更新数据
     *
     * @param userId                          	   用户id
     * @param $!{entityDetailDTO}				   请求对象
     */
    void update$!{Entity}(Long userId, $!{EntityDetailDTO} $!{entityDetailDTO});

    /**
     * 根据主键获取数据
     *
     * @param id 主键
     * @return 数据
     */
    $!{EntityDetailDTO} get$!{Entity}ById(Long id);

    /**
     * 分页查询
     *
     * @param $!{entityQueryDTO} 			 查询条件
     * @param pageSize                       每页大小
     * @param pageNum                        当前页
     * @param sortProperty                   排序字段
     * @param sortDirection                  排序方向
     * @return 分页结果
     */
    NormPagingResult<$!{EntityPageDTO}> pageQuery($!{EntityQueryDTO} $!{entityQueryDTO}, Integer pageSize,
                                                              Integer pageNum, String sortProperty, SortDirection sortDirection);

}
